# TIANZE Fiber Materials

TIANZE supplies standard and specialty optical fiber coatings and fiber/photonics assembly adhesives.

- Website: https://novelpolymer.cn/
- Contact: mike@novelpolymer.cn
- Fiber coatings: https://novelpolymer.cn/optical-fiber-coatings/
- Low-refractive-index coatings: https://novelpolymer.cn/low-refractive-index-fiber-coatings/
- Polarization-maintaining fiber coatings: https://novelpolymer.cn/polarization-maintaining-fiber-coating/
- PI-250 polyimide coating: https://novelpolymer.cn/polyimide-optical-fiber-coating/
- Microbend-resistant coating: https://novelpolymer.cn/microbend-resistant-fiber-coating/
- Radiation-resistant coating: https://novelpolymer.cn/radiation-resistant-fiber-coating/
- Fiber and photonics adhesives: https://novelpolymer.cn/fiber-photonics-adhesives/
- FAU head and tail adhesives: https://novelpolymer.cn/fau-head-tail-adhesives/
- PLC/AWG coupling adhesives: https://novelpolymer.cn/plc-awg-coupling-adhesives/
- Ceramic ferrule potting and process materials: https://novelpolymer.cn/ceramic-ferrule-potting-adhesives/
- 3316 optical fiber bonding adhesive: https://novelpolymer.cn/optical-fiber-bonding-adhesive/
- Intermittently bonded ribbon adhesive: https://novelpolymer.cn/intermittently-bonded-ribbon-adhesive/
- Technical guides: https://novelpolymer.cn/technical-guides/
- Optical fiber coating selection guide: https://novelpolymer.cn/optical-fiber-coating-selection-guide/
- Refractive-index specification guide: https://novelpolymer.cn/optical-fiber-coating-refractive-index-guide/
- FAU adhesive selection guide: https://novelpolymer.cn/fau-adhesive-selection-guide/

Public numerical values appear only where approved data is available. Application suitability requires evaluation in the intended fiber or assembly process.
